nodes.name: Get Queued Listings
nodes.notes: Manual override: a fresh pending batch (pasted from the browser when the scrape is blocked) is used instead of scraping.

parameters.query: SELECT id, listings FROM listing_queue WHERE status = 'pending' AND submitted_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND jsonb_typeof(listings) = 'array' AND listings->0->>'mls_id' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY submitted_at DESC LIMIT 1

nodes.name: Scrape Office Listings
nodes.notes: Best-effort scrape run. On any error (Apify failure, timeout), onError:continue passes an error item through so Parse Listings/Scrape Failed? can detect it and route to the abort-alert path instead of a generic workflow crash.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { startUrls: [{ url: 'https://www.teamyellownow.com/index.php?showagency=1' }], pageFunction: "async function pageFunction(context) { const { page } = context; await page.waitForSelector('.vertical-listing-card', { timeout: 30000 }); return await page.$$eval('.vertical-listing-card', (nodes) => nodes.map((card) => { const saveEl = card.querySelector('.saveListing'); const priceEl = card.querySelector('.card-title'); const addressEl = card.querySelector('p b.text-mute'); const imgEl = card.querySelector('img.card-img-top'); const nums = Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('.card-text b')).map((b) => b.textContent.trim()); return { mls_id: saveEl ? saveEl.getAttribute('data-mlsid') : null, price: priceEl ? priceEl.textContent.trim() : null, beds: nums[0] || null, baths: nums[1] || null, sqft: nums[2] || null, address: addressEl ? addressEl.textContent.trim() : null, url: card.getAttribute('data-link'), photo_thumb_url: imgEl ? imgEl.getAttribute('src') : null }; })); }", proxyConfiguration: { useApifyProxy: true, apifyProxyGroups: ['RESIDENTIAL'], apifyProxyCountry: 'US' }, maxPagesPerCrawl: 1, maxResultRecords: 30, pageLoadTimeoutSecs: 90 } }}

nodes.name: Canary Send
nodes.notes: Pre-flight: one canary email to hello@norrai.co. If SendGrid is unhealthy this errors (onError:continue) and the workflow aborts the blast instead of silently no-opping 899 sends.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { personalizations: [{ to: [{ email: 'hello@norrai.co' }] }], from: { email: 'hello@norrai.co', name: 'Norr AI' }, subject: 'Weekly Drip preflight — SendGrid OK', content: [{ type: 'text/plain', value: 'SendGrid preflight passed for the weekly marketing drip. ' + $('Build Cards').first().json.listing_count + ' listing(s)' + ($('Build Cards').first().json.used_fallback ? ' (fallback — no new listings this week)' : '') + '. The blast to the CRM list follows.' }] } }}
